findings.title: bom defaults to on, so backups get the mark too and restoring one silently loads no contacts
findings.trigger: write_backup calls write_contacts without the new flag, so every backup now starts with a byte-order mark. restore_backup opens the file as plain utf-8, so csv.DictReader reads the first header as a BOM followed by 'email'; row.get('email') is None for every row and read_contacts skips them all.
findings.impact: restore_backup returns an empty book and restore_into reports 0 changes with no error, so a restore after data loss restores nothing. Default bom to False (the download already passes bom=True), or make read_contacts tolerate the mark, and add a backup-then-restore test.
